messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a small canary for quantized runtime + new matmul kernel during the 03:00 UTC change window tonight. Target pool: canary-gpu-a (3 nodes).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start for 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z (thread 1793456102). Rolling to 1 of 3 nodes over 5m.

sam: what's our rollback threshold? latency + error budget or correctness checks?

oliver: prefer correctness-first. if top-level response delta > 1% or any NaNs/errors in outputs, rollback immediately. also track p50/p95 latency and token costs.

linh: note last time matmul kernel v3 caused tiny negative probs for softmax in 90-token runs, triggered by int8 path. we should pin kernels on fallback hosts.

oliver: agree. proposed policy:
- quick rollback on correctness (any NaN/out-of-range)
- 15% tail-latency regression over baseline -> alert, but allow 30m to stabilize
- automatic pin to kernel v2 for hostpool if rollback triggered

sam: add automated snapshot of failing traces + prompt set. saves time.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started on canary-gpu-a-1 at 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z.


Sidenote: small typo in the bot name earlier, ignore.

sre-bot: metric watch: p95 +12% after 6m on canary-gpu-a-1; error rate 0.0. no NaNs.

linh: check KV cache mismatch logs, sometimes causes spikes. paste logs if you see it.

deploy-bot: canary-gpu-a-2 started -> saw `runtime/kernel: matmul v3 mismatch on cuda-cu124` on init for one container. attaching snippet:

```
[03:06:12] runtime/kernel: loaded matmul_v3.so
[03:06:14] runtime/kernel: WARN: kernel ABI mismatched, fallback attempted
[03:06:15] runtime/exec: ERROR compute: detected NaN in output tensor, request id=usr-9832
```

oliver: that's the regress we feared. rollback now?

sam: yes. pin plan: set hostpool canary-gpu-a pin kernel=v2, abort rollout, and force previous model binary for canary nodes.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: pin kernel=v2 on canary-gpu-a (3 nodes) and aborting remainder of rollout. Started at 2026-03-20T03:08:10Z.

sre-bot: All canary nodes reverted. telemetry indicates p95 back to baseline within 40s. No customer impact.

linh: I'll open a hotfix CI run to repro and patch matmul v3 ABI in build. assigning to @oliver for kernel ABI fix.

oliver: on it. I'll run a reproducer against the failing env and bump build flags. ETA 3h.

maya: Good call. Action items:
- oliver: root cause and patch (ETA 3h)
- linh: CI reproducer + regression test
- sam: update release notes + canary checklist to include ABI smoke
- eng-oncall: extend change window standby by 1h tonight

maya: I'll post a short note in #eng-releases and update the changelog entry to say we've aborted canary and pinned kernel v2. :white_check_mark:

sam: add a quick line to rollback policy doc about pinning hostpools on runtime regressions.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Thread closed at 2026-03-20T03:10:05Z.

maya: Thanks everyone, great coordination. :pray:
